description: This file provides utility functions and type definitions for handling Android native buffers and hardware buffers within the ANGLE project, including conversions between different buffer types, querying buffer properties, and mapping pixel formats to OpenGL formats.

classes.name: native_handle_t
classes.description: Structure representing a native handle with version, file descriptor count, integer count, and data array.

classes.name: buffer_handle_t
classes.description: Type alias for a constant pointer to native_handle_t, representing a buffer handle.

classes.name: android_native_base_t
classes.description: Base structure for Android native objects with reference counting.

classes.name: ANativeWindowBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing an Android native window buffer with properties like width, height, format, and a handle.

methods.name: ClientBufferToANativeWindowBuffer
methods.description: Converts an EGLClientBuffer to an ANativeWindowBuffer pointer via reinterpret_cast.

methods.name: GetANativeWindowBufferProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as width, height, layer count (depth), and format from an ANativeWindowBuffer.

methods.name: NativePixelFormatToGLInternalFormat
methods.description: Maps Android hardware buffer pixel formats to corresponding OpenGL internal formats.

methods.name: ANativeWindowBufferToAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Converts an ANativeWindowBuffer pointer to an AHardwareBuffer pointer using pointer offset.

methods.name: AHardwareBufferToClientBuffer
methods.description: Converts an AHardwareBuffer pointer to an EGLClientBuffer using pointer offset.
